descriptionChirho: Aramaic adjective meaning 'another, other,' used attributively or predicatively in Daniel. English 'another / and–other,' Spanish 'otro / otra / y–el–otro,' Hindi 'दूसरा / और–दूसरे,' Arabic 'آخَرُ / أُخْرَى / وَ–الْآخَرِ,' Korean '다른 / 그리고–다른것이,' Swahili 'mwingine / nyingine / na–nyingine.' The two clusters differ only in whether the adjective appears standalone (5x) or with the conjunctive waw prefix (1x); both feminine and masculine forms convey the identical adjectival sense of 'another, different one.'
